name: ltx-2-3-dev

resources.videoSecondsTypical: ~60-180s per 5s clip on RTX 4090; ~30-90s on A100/H100

notes: Full-quality LTX-2.3 — 22B-parameter base, 30-step inference, higher resolution defaults (1216×704 @ 30fps), synchronized audio generation. Use when output quality matters more than iteration speed (final renders, hero content, production deliverables). Requires 24GB+ VRAM; the runner enables cpu offload automatically on the dev variant to keep it usable on RTX 4090. For iteration work, use ltx-2-3-distilled instead. Same Apache 2.0 license.
